entries.name: On Evade / On Crit (+ Wielding: Polearm)

system.description: Lightweight armor made from a magical Griffon.
A lightweight spear that trades power for precision and ease of mobility.
A versatile spear that can be thrown at range.

Toggle between being mounted on your pegasus or being unmounted. 

While mounted in this way, this unit becomes a Flying unit. Flying units cannot be attacked in melee, except by other Flying units. They may still be counterattacked in melee by any unit, if the Flying unit initiates the attack against them.

While mounted and Grounded, this unit also counts as a Cavalry unit.

effects.name: Mounted: Pegasus
effects.description:
Mount Bonuses: +2 Mov, +2 HP, +2 Eva, +2 Spd

Unit Types: Flying
